name: Methyl levulinate
about: Measured values each record of this component was fitted to (validation/python/measured_components.py). test/properties.test.js checks that the coefficients in src/data/components.json reproduce them within the maximum deviation stated in each record.

source.name: Measured densities of the liquid at 0.1 MPa (NIST TRC ThermoML Archive)

source.fit: 25 Clapeyron values and 0 measured values, 293.50-453.15 K, max deviation 0.67 %

source.name: measured vapour pressures and the critical point
source.fit: 39 measured values (38 from the ThermoML Archive) and the critical point, 293.50-668.00 K, max deviation 8.3 %. Between 453.15 K and the critical point the curve is held only by the critical point. All the measured sets fitted together, each article with the same weight (no set preferred for a smaller stated uncertainty), pooled because they agree: each set lies within its mean stated uncertainty of the curve on average; mean deviation of the fit from each set: Emel'yanenko 2018 -4.60 %; Lomba 2013 +0.42 %.

references: Nikitin 2019 (critical point, NIST TRC ThermoML Archive)
